tasteReview.evaluator: npx tsx scripts/taste-evaluate.ts cities --builder claude-opus-5-5 --evaluator claude --url http://127.0.0.1:3311/cities --shots <the 8 files below>. The grok CLI and the Cursor CLI are missing in this sandbox, so the judge is the chain's claude link (claude CLI, the sonnet alias pinned to claude-sonnet-5, subscription): three scorings of these shots in one call, recorded exactly as returned, no re-roll. The builder (the dial-finish lane, claude-opus-5-5) is not the judge.

tasteReview.beats: Zillow Bend homes directory (https://www.zillow.com/bend-or/) — this page wins on market depth: the MOS overlay panel gives a seller's/buyer's-market read per city in one control, something Zillow's plain city list doesn't attempt. It does not win on map density or saved-search tooling, and the directory grid itself is still a weaker version of Zillow's own tile-with-count pattern, not a clear beat.

defects.finding: The opened panel is a static cream list with per-city sliders, not the catalog combobox's morphing/filtering interaction — nothing in the shot suggests type-to-filter or a focus morph, just a dropdown that happens to carry the combobox label.
At 375px the pin labels collide — "Powell Butte" overlaps the "650 homes $430k" tag, and the floating Jax badge sits directly on top of the "8 homes $1.3M" pin, making both unreadable.

The underline bar beneath each city name is too thin and too close in length across cards to actually let a visitor compare 725 vs. 259 vs. 48 at a glance — you still have to read the numeral, so the "shared-scale mark instead of a bare numeral" fix from the reference file only half-landed.

defects.section: Section rhythm (Central Oregon / Directory / Cities on the Map / Overlay)
defects.finding: Four consecutive section openers use the same eyebrow-caps-then-bold-heading beat with no variation in width, density, or type scale, so the page reads as one long form repeated rather than four distinct moments.

The price-ladder scrubber and "Near this price" comp list are the strongest section on the page but the thumbnail rail beneath it is a plain 6-up photo strip with price/bd captions — no card-body detail (sqft, $/sqft) visible until you click into the big card, so the rail itself still reads as a generic carousel.

tasteReview.verdict: This is a page that genuinely tried to answer Matt's 'wall of text, scrolling lists' complaint — it has a real styled map, a seller/buyer MOS overlay, and a price-ladder scrubber with comps, which is more interaction than the 2026-09-08 mark (30) implies existed before. But demoMatch is false: the combobox is a cream panel, not the catalog's morphing search, and craft slips at mobile width where map labels and the floating Jax badge collide. The directory grid at the top — the section most visitors see first — is still the dullest thing on the page, and the eyebrow-heading rhythm repeats enough times down the fold to read as one stacked form rather than four considered sections.
tells: The stacked-section page. — "Central Oregon" / "Directory" / "Cities on the Map" / "Overlay a City Against the Region" all open with the identical small-caps eyebrow + bold-heading beat, varying only what sits underneath.

Cream box. — the "Search a city…" control opens into a flat, bordered cream panel of static rows (Bend / La Pine / Madras, each with a slider); there is no morph, no match-highlighting, nothing that reads as the catalog combobox interaction — it is a restyled dropdown wearing the name.
tasteReview.dullest: The 'Tap a city' photo grid: six same-size thumbnails with a caption and a count underneath. Even with the new underline bar it is still functionally Zillow's city picker — pretty photos standing in for data, not a real encoding of magnitude.
tasteReview.rebaselineReason: evaluatorModel grok-4.6 to claude-sonnet-5 (the chain's claude link; the grok links are missing in this sandbox) and shotsHash (the shelves under the fold are listing dials, 2026-10-01). Same-ruler mark: main's /cities on claude-sonnet-5 the same day scored [63, 57, 62], median 62; this tree scores 64.

contentFloor.note: No-regression floor (ci:route-content-floor). A build under any number here fails before the evaluator runs. Lower a number only by hand, in the same commit, with the reason. heroImageNatural LOWERED 2043 -> 1382 (2026-09-23, PR #352 blocker; same root cause PR #351 found on oregon-city/place-type-community): the 2026-09-12 seed read heroImageWidth 120 / heroImageNatural 2271, which is exactly public/images/brand/logo-horizontal-navy-transparent.png (2271x454), the header wordmark, winning the widest-in-fold comparison on a page with no photographic hero. The /cities directory (SITE-161 fold: photo + name + live count in the first viewport) now puts a real city photo inside 1200px, rendered wider than the 120px logo, and that photo is delivered at 1536px natural (measured in PR #352 CI runs 35826352263 and 35860657259, identical both times). 1382 = floor(1536 * 0.9), the gate's own 0.9 tolerance on the real photo instead of the logo asset.
